model.architecture_family: decoder-only Transformer (dense, Qwen2 architecture, unchanged by conversion)
model.intended_use: MLX-format repackaging of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (BF16 weights) for local inference on Apple silicon via mlx-lm; same general-assistant / instruction-following use case as the source model.
capabilities: multilingual interaction across 29+ languages per source model (inherited)
limitations: inherits all base-model limitations and biases (no new training)
no independent safety evaluation of the converted artifact
shipped config.json caps native context at 32,768 tokens; the source model's full 131,072-token context requires enabling YaRN RoPE scaling, which is not set in this repo's config.json
requires mlx-lm / Apple silicon runtime to load

references.title: Qwen2.5: A Party of Foundation Models!

provenance.notes: The mlx-community card states this repo was converted to MLX format from Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct using mlx-lm version 0.18.1. Weights are kept at BF16 precision; no additional training, fine-tuning, or dataset use is reported. Repo created 2024-09-18, immediately after the Qwen2.5 release (2024-09-19).

transformation.objective: Repackage the BF16 safetensors weights of Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct into Apple's MLX array/model format so the model can be loaded and run locally with mlx-lm on Apple silicon.
transformation.notes: Conversion tool: mlx-lm 0.18.1 (per model card). No training data was used; this is a lossless-precision format/runtime conversion (BF16 -> BF16 MLX arrays), not a quantization or fine-tune. Exact conversion command/flags and numerical-equivalence tests are not published.

safety.risk_level: Inherited from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; the MLX conversion reports no independent safety evaluation or new risk-mitigation work.

items.description: As a format conversion, this artifact carries the same general LLM risks as the source model (hallucination, bias, unsafe or inaccurate outputs) with no additional mitigation applied during conversion.

licenses.name: Apache License 2.0
licenses.scope_note: Inherited from the source model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; both the mlx-community card's HF metadata and the source model declare license 'apache-2.0', and no separate license is issued for the MLX conversion.
